try-main.text: Play it: pick a uniform in 02, press Set 3 uniforms, then Undo. Hover a role card: the line under the cards says what happens to it. Dashed shirt = no uniform, gets one; grey shirt with a lock = has one, never touched.

try-uniformsall.text: Click “Leave it out” on the refused shop: the verdict turns green and Apply unlocks for the other six. Hover a row for its roles.

try-imports.text: Grey bar = what the contract holds now, green = what the write adds, red hatching past the cap = what the importers' caps leave uncovered. A tank is Smart Delivery (a stock level), a truck is a weekly amount.

try-schedule.text: Hover a day's bars for its entries and hours. In 02, flip the open-0-to-24 switch: the new hours in the strip go back to closed.

try-scheduleall.text: The dots under the title are the run: green written, hollow skipped, the ringed one on screen.

try-permission.text: Replaces the pairing code. The board's dialog waits while the game asks; one Allow per browser.

try-states.text: The wire under each title is the state at a glance: blue travelling asks, green agrees, red refuses, amber waits or moved on, grey is busy.

try-buttons.text: Hover a green button: a packet runs from the board's dot to the game.

try-phoneuniforms.text: At phone width the dialog is a bottom sheet; the role cards stay two to a row and the buttons go full width.

try-phoneimports.text: Imports cards stack; nothing scrolls sideways. The sheet scrolls inside itself.

try-phoneundo.text: After closing: the Undo strip sits above the board's foot.
